item.title: resumOpenAI: An Evidence-aware Resume Generation PoC
item.description:
Project resources

Public portfolio index and evidence status.

  • GitHub project indexgithub.com/HeungJAELEE

A dedicated public source repository and separate public report have not been registered for this PoC. The article describes the design and verification boundary without labeling another repository as its source.

Public PDD · Prototype Backlog

Project definition and execution plan

The PoC prioritizes fact traceability, personal-data minimization, and structured validation before polished LLM wording.

PoC design public · dedicated source not public
Project type
Personal LLM application PoC
My scope
React, Flask, LLM boundaries and validation design
Primary audience
Job seekers and career-document authors
Evidence level
Design-led · no dedicated repository registered

Problem

If polished LLM wording changes dates, roles, or metrics, or sends unnecessary personal data to an external API, the resume becomes less trustworthy.
